purpose: Re-run the same viewed Stage 11 datasets using the evaluator implementation with alternative evidence-group support.
note: Existing datasets use one gold evidence group per answerable item. No blind or independent set was added; new group-completion metrics describe the completeness of those existing gold groups only.

reports.provenance: Agent-authored targeted bilingual stress suite frozen before first run of the concept checker. Not blind or independent clinical validation; some facts overlap earlier gold. Do not tune against these results and call them held-out.
